vignette.story: John is a dedicated high school teacher who takes pride in his students' achievements and challenges. His coworkers are fellow educators and staff members at Lincoln High School, who often share insights and support each other through a Slack channel called "Lincoln Educators Forum." John is considering sharing some recent classroom experiences to get advice on teaching strategies. He checked his personal Notion notebook, which he affectionately refers to as "The Educator's Companion," and found detailed notes on a particular student's poor performance and low grades on the most recent test, which he initially recorded for his own reference. He also found a general observation about the class's overall engagement and participation during the test review session, which could be useful for a discussion on teaching methods in the "Lincoln Educators Forum."
